Tracking Experience & Demo Controls.question: How should applicants and returning users access the application tracking feature?
Tracking Experience & Demo Controls.answer: Dual Access — Embed live timeline directly on the Stage 5 Confirmation screen, and add a "Track Application" action in the AppHeader that opens a reference lookup modal anytime
options_presented: Dual Access — Embed live timeline directly on the Stage 5 Confirmation screen, and add a "Track Application" action in the AppHeader that opens a reference lookup modal anytime
Standalone Tracker View — Add a top-level toggle in the app shell between "Application Form" and "Track Application" screen
Confirmation Screen Only — Tracking timeline only lives on Stage 5; returning users must use a deep link with their reference number

Tracking Experience & Demo Controls.question: How should the mocked demo timeline transitions and status change alerts (TRCK-02) work?
Tracking Experience & Demo Controls.answer: Interactive Demo Controller + Toast Alerts — Include a test/demo scenario bar (similar to Phase 4 payment bar) with "[Advance Status]", "[Simulate Info Request]", and "[Simulate Approval]" buttons that trigger live status change toast alerts
options_presented: Interactive Demo Controller + Toast Alerts — Include a test/demo scenario bar (similar to Phase 4 payment bar) with "[Advance Status]", "[Simulate Info Request]", and "[Simulate Approval]" buttons that trigger live status change toast alerts
Auto-Timer Simulation — Automatically advance the mock timeline every 15-30 seconds with status change notifications popping up
Static Mock Stages — Render deterministic timeline dates based on the reference number with no runtime state transitions

Tracking Experience & Demo Controls.answer: Web Share API + WhatsApp Deep-Link + Copy Button — Use navigator.share on supported mobile devices, with fallback to direct WhatsApp URL (wa.me/?text=...) and a 1-tap "Copy Reference & Link" button with toast feedback
options_presented: Web Share API + WhatsApp Deep-Link + Copy Button — Use navigator.share on supported mobile devices, with fallback to direct WhatsApp URL (wa.me/?text=...) and a 1-tap "Copy Reference & Link" button with toast feedback
Dedicated WhatsApp & SMS Buttons — Render separate green "Share via WhatsApp" and "Share via SMS" buttons alongside reference copy
Simple Copy to Clipboard Only — Provide a copy button for the reference number with a template text popup

Tracking Experience & Demo Controls.question: How should simulated SMS/email confirmation notifications (CNFRM-04) be presented to the user?
Tracking Experience & Demo Controls.answer: In-App Toasts + Expandable Message Preview Card — Trigger toasts for dispatched SMS/email and render a "Sent Notifications" preview card showing the simulated message templates directly on Stage 5
options_presented: In-App Toasts + Expandable Message Preview Card — Trigger toasts for dispatched SMS/email and render a "Sent Notifications" preview card showing the simulated message templates directly on Stage 5
Toasts + Console Logging Only — Show brief toast alerts and log full notification payloads to browser console via INotificationService

Interview Checklist & Next Steps Format.question: How should the Interview Prep & Next Steps checklist content (CNFRM-03) be structured?
Interview Checklist & Next Steps Format.answer: Visa-Specific Tailored Checklist — Dynamically customize checklist items based on applicant's destination and visa type (e.g., Student visas include university admission/funds, Business includes employer sponsorship, Tourist includes travel itinerary)
options_presented: Visa-Specific Tailored Checklist — Dynamically customize checklist items based on applicant's destination and visa type (e.g., Student visas include university admission/funds, Business includes employer sponsorship, Tourist includes travel itinerary)
Universal Embassy Checklist — Standardized single checklist applicable to all visa applicants covering passport, appointment letters, biometrics, and fee receipts

Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.question: What format should the cross-device draft backup code (STATE-05) use?
Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.answer: 8-Character Alphanumeric Code (e.g., VR-784291) — Human-readable short code saved in a mock cloud registry that restores draft state on any device with simple typing
options_presented: 8-Character Alphanumeric Code (e.g., VR-784291) — Human-readable short code saved in a mock cloud registry that restores draft state on any device with simple typing
Direct Magic Link / QR Code — Generate a shareable URL containing the encoded draft parameters that opens and restores the draft automatically
Base64 JSON Draft Token — Self-contained encrypted/encoded string containing full answers that can be exported and pasted anywhere

Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.question: Where should applicants be able to generate their draft backup code?
Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.answer: Save Indicator + AppHeader / ResumeBanner — Make the "Saved" indicator and AppHeader clickable to open a "Backup Draft" modal to enter email, receive simulated code, and copy it anytime
options_presented: Save Indicator + AppHeader / ResumeBanner — Make the "Saved" indicator and AppHeader clickable to open a "Backup Draft" modal to enter email, receive simulated code, and copy it anytime
Floating "Save & Backup" Button — Persistent floating action button on mobile bottom bar allowing instant code generation
Stage-Completion Prompts — Automatically prompt the user to generate an email backup code after completing each major stage

Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.question: How should the draft restore flow handle conflicts with existing local draft data?
Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.answer: Conflict Warning with Draft Comparison — If local draft data exists, show a modal comparing the current local draft vs the remote backup before overwriting, with clear "[Replace Local Draft]" or "[Keep Current]" buttons
options_presented: Conflict Warning with Draft Comparison — If local draft data exists, show a modal comparing the current local draft vs the remote backup before overwriting, with clear "[Replace Local Draft]" or "[Keep Current]" buttons
Silent Instant Overwrite + Undo Toast — Overwrite immediately on valid code and show a toast with an "[Undo]" action
Strict Block — Require the user to click "Start Over" first if an existing draft is detected before allowing a code to be entered

Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.question: How should document attachments be handled during cross-device draft backup and restore?
Cross-Device Draft Backup & Restore Code.answer: Full Mock Cloud Registry (Preserves Attachments) — Store the draft snapshot including mock document metadata and lightweight preview blobs in the mock registry so restore provides 100% complete state
options_presented: Full Mock Cloud Registry (Preserves Attachments) — Store the draft snapshot including mock document metadata and lightweight preview blobs in the mock registry so restore provides 100% complete state
Metadata-Only Restore with Re-Attach Notice — Restore answers and file names/sizes, but mark slots as needing re-verification on the new device
